decision_actor.tool: Connected GitHub source records and public original journal/institutional abstract text via web; no article PDF or audio

rationale: Four earlier original candidates already have accepted canonical title/abstract records. Their full-text gate remains blocked by original PDF manifestations; select two other already-identified publications with actually consulted original abstract text rather than repeat those records.

cases.exact_edition: Applied Ergonomics 45(5), 1291–1296, September 2014; online date 2013-10-24 appears in PubMed but not equated to final issue
cases.title: Learning three sets of alarms for the same medical functions: a perspective on the difficulty of learning alarms specified in an international standard.
cases.read_locator: University of Plymouth institutional article entry: Abstract, complete publicly presented abstract text; no Methods/Results beyond abstract
cases.access_method: public institutional HTML via web text, unauthenticated
cases.reasoning: Institutional original abstract describes human participants learning three sets of eight medical alarms: standard tonal, randomly selected abstract, and function-metaphor alarms, over ten trial blocks. Alarm identification/learnability is measured and results summarized. Inclusion is to full-text retrieval only; no population N, effect size, original stimuli or statistical result is extracted.
cases.identity_limit: One article; multiple preserved search paths are occurrences, not multiple papers. No sample count or cohort independence from earlier Edworthy work asserted.
cases.next_gate: Full text and lawful original manifestation acquisition; register R006 source-pinned reading and canonical TA SCR only via Integration serialization/validation after source-scoped review.

cases.title: Speech Auditory Alerts Promote Memory for Alerted Events in a Video-Simulated Self-Driving Car Ride
cases.read_locator: SAGE original publisher HTML: full displayed Abstract (Objective, Background, Method, Results, Conclusion, Application); published full article labelled restricted access
cases.access_method: public SAGE publisher abstract via web text, unauthenticated
cases.reasoning: Publisher original abstract reports experimental comparison of speech vehicle-status alerts, auditory icons and a visual control during a video-simulated autonomous-car ride and secondary visual task, assessing event memory and subjective effort/annoyance. This is an abstract-level candidate only; reported findings are not extracted as quantitative results.
cases.identity_limit: Single publication/source; distinct from Edworthy 2014 by DOI/title/author and application. No study or independent participant sample is instantiated; actual methods and shared participants remain full-text questions.
cases.next_gate: Retrieve lawful original publisher/author full text or retain awaiting_text if unavailable; canonical TA admission belongs to Integration's serialized records/export process.

limits: First-pass single AI-assisted screening only; no human reviewer or independent intra-agent pass represented.

Two source identities are already accepted R006 identity records, but both have access_status metadata_only and no original PDF manifestation in those records; the new abstract observations are in this bounded noncanonical packet only.
No canonical SCR written and no changes to shared manifests, evidence-flow, R005 hits or R004 sources.
Existing four-candidate FT gate remains blocked: Becker and Romeo 2025 require exact original-file manifestations; Romeo 2023 original IEEE Methods absent.
